title: How TSMC Became Indispensable to Advanced Computing
subtitle: A production acceptance project for FLVYT

beats.text: The world's most advanced chips depend on a company most consumers have never heard of.
TSMC built its business around manufacturing chips designed by other companies.
Advanced semiconductor manufacturing is extraordinarily capital intensive.
beats.label: FAB SCALE

beats.text: That manufacturing specialization became a critical link between chip designers and the devices built around them.
FLVYT acceptance gate: every scene must remain grounded, timed to narration, rendered and technically validated.
